units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:3">Pes. I, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 10b:14">10ᵇ</cite>) <he>בתוך המ׳</he> within the time appointed for the removal of leavened matter (up to the sixth hour of the day); <he>אחר המ׳</he> after the time (until nightfall), Rashi; (oth. interpret., v. infra).—Pl. <he>מוֹעֲדִים</he>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 54b:25">Erub. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>עשה מ׳ לתורה</he> have fixed times for the study of the Law, v. <cite ref="M00411"><he>מוֹדִיעַ</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: festive season, festival, esp. = חוֹל הַמּ׳, the week-days intervening between the first and the last days of Passover and of Succoth.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:1">M. Kat. I, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Pes. l. c. <he>בתוך המ׳</he> during the festive week of Passover; <he>לאחר המ׳</he> after Passover, Tosaf.; (oth. interpret., v. supra).—Pl. <he>מוֹעֲדִים</he>, <he>מוֹעֲדוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:6">Pes. X, 6</cite> <he>מ׳ ורגלים אחרים</he> other seasons and festivals.

Sabb. 145ᵇ מ׳ שבבל שמחים the festivals in Babylonia are joyously celebrated; a. fr.—מ׳ קטן Moʿed Katon, (half-festival) name of a treatise of the Mishnah, Tosefta, Talmud Babli and Y’rushalmi, of the Order of Moʿed.—סדר מ׳ the Order of Moʿed, name of the second order of the Mishnah, Tosefta and Talmud Babli and Y’rushalmi.
